findings.en_sentence: The largest known specimen is estimated to be 10 meters long and weigh about 1414 kilograms.
findings.es_sentence: El ejemplar más grande conocido se estima que mide 10 metros de longitud y pesa unos 1414 kilogramos.
findings.problem: Xu et al. 2012 give about 9 m for the holotype together with the 1,414 kg mass. The 10 m figure from this enwiki revision does not go with that mass, and eswiki (F030) says 9 m.
findings.correct: The holotype, the largest specimen, is estimated at about 9 m long and about 1,414 kg.
findings.checked_in: F012 vs F029/F030 (eswiki), Xu et al. 2012 (knowledge)

findings.en_sentence: Yutyrannus lived during the Early Cretaceous in what is now northeastern China, while other age estimates suggest it originated from the mid-Cretaceous, approximately 125 million years ago in the Aptian stage, in what is now Asia.
findings.problem: Presents 'mid-Cretaceous' and 'Aptian' as an alternative to 'Early Cretaceous', but the Aptian is part of the Early Cretaceous. About 125 Ma is Barremian (enwiki F010), not Aptian. The sentence also repeats the location.
findings.correct: Yutyrannus lived in the Early Cretaceous, about 125 million years ago (Barremian–early Aptian), in what is now northeastern China.
findings.checked_in: F005, F010 (enwiki Discovery), F027 (eswiki), F056 (PBDB), ICS chart (knowledge)

findings.en_sentence: The environment where Yutyrannus lived was comparable to modern temperate tropical rainforests in British Columbia and experienced significant seasonal temperature changes.
findings.es_sentence: El entorno donde vivió Yutyrannus era comparable a las selvas tropicales templadas modernas de Columbia Británica y experimentó cambios estacionales significativos de temperatura.
findings.problem: 'Temperate tropical' contradicts itself. Enwiki says temperate rainforests; the eswiki source (F053) mistranslated it. The 10 °C climate cited elsewhere on the page is not tropical either.
findings.correct: comparable to the modern temperate rainforests of British Columbia / comparable a los bosques lluviosos templados actuales de la Columbia Británica

findings.en_sentence: Phylogenetic analyses consistently place Yutyrannus within the group Tyrannosauroidea, specifically in the parent group Proceratosauridae.
findings.problem: Only the Tyrannosauroidea placement is consistent across analyses. Proceratosauridae comes from one analysis (Carr & Brusatte 2016) and the PBDB, and other analyses recover it outside that family.
findings.correct: All analyses place Yutyrannus in Tyrannosauroidea; some, such as Brusatte & Carr 2016, place it in Proceratosauridae.

findings.en_sentence: Some paleontologists, including Xu Xing, suggest that Yutyrannus hunted in packs because the three known individuals were found together.
findings.es_sentence: Algunos paleontólogos, incluido Xu Xing, sugieren que Yutyrannus cazaba en manada porque los tres individuos conocidos fueron hallados juntos.
findings.problem: Both sources say the three individuals were 'allegedly' found together (they came through dealers and their provenance is uncertain). The text states it as fact.
findings.correct: ...because the three known individuals were reportedly found together / ...porque los tres individuos supuestamente se hallaron juntos.

findings.en_sentence: Age estimates suggest Yutyrannus originated from the Lujiatun or Jianshangou beds of the Yixian Formation.
findings.es_sentence: Las estimaciones de edad sugieren que Yutyrannus se originó en los lechos de Lujiatun o Jianshangou de la Formación Yixian.
findings.problem: 'Originated' / 'se originó' reads as the taxon's evolutionary origin; the source means the specimens come from these beds. In Spanish, 'lechos' is a calque: these units are 'capas' or 'miembros'.
findings.correct: The specimens probably come from the Lujiatun or Jianshangou beds... / Los fósiles proceden probablemente de las capas (miembros) de Lujiatun o Jianshangou de la Formación Yixian.

findings.en_sentence: Yutyrannus lived during the Early Cretaceous in what is now northeastern China, while other age estimates suggest it originated from the mid-Cretaceous, approximately 125 million years ago in the Aptian stage, in what is now Asia.
findings.problem: The Spanish page leaves out the period and age entirely. It also drops the classification sentences (proceratosaurid tyrannosauroid, large bipedal predator), so a Spanish reader never learns when it lived or what it was.
findings.correct: Add the equivalents: 'Vivió a principios del Cretácico, hace unos 125 millones de años, en el noreste de China' and its classification as a tiranosauroideo.

findings.en_sentence: This proceratosaurid tyrannosauroid dinosaur, meaning "feathered tyrant," was a large bipedal predator.
findings.problem: The participle 'meaning "feathered tyrant"' attaches to 'dinosaur' instead of the name. It also repeats the etymology given in the previous sentence.
findings.correct: This proceratosaurid tyrannosauroid was a large bipedal predator.

findings.en_sentence: The genus was described by Xu and colleagues in 2012, who named and described Yutyrannus huali.
findings.es_sentence: El género fue descrito por Xu y sus colaboradores en 2012, quienes nombraron y describieron a Yutyrannus huali.
findings.problem: Says 'described' twice. The next sentence also repeats the Liaoning location already given in curiosities.
findings.correct: Xu Xing and colleagues named and described Yutyrannus huali in 2012.

findings.en_sentence: The true cause of death for the known Yutyrannus specimens remains unknown.
findings.es_sentence: La causa real de la muerte de los especímenes conocidos de Yutyrannus sigue siendo desconocida.
findings.problem: 'True' answers a hypothesis the page never states: Xu's idea that the three died during a sauropod hunt (F051) was dropped.
findings.correct: State Xu's idea that they may have died together while hunting, then say the cause of death is unknown.

findings.en_sentence: It is debated whether the skin of later tyrannosaurids developed scales secondarily in response to body size, warmer climates, or other factors.
findings.es_sentence: Se debate si la piel de los tiranosáuridos posteriores desarrolló escamas de forma secundaria en respuesta al tamaño corporal, climas más cálidos u otros factores.
findings.problem: The source is conditional: if scaly skin dominated in later genera, the covering may have changed with size or climate. Scaly skin is documented in later tyrannosaurids (Bell et al. 2017); the open question is why.
findings.correct: Later tyrannosaurids show scaly skin; this may reflect changes with body size, warmer climates or other factors.

findings.en_sentence: The largest known specimen is estimated to be 10 meters long and weigh about 1414 kilograms.
findings.es_sentence: El ejemplar más grande conocido se estima que mide 10 metros de longitud y pesa unos 1414 kilogramos.
findings.problem: Anacoluthon: the subject is fronted, then 'se estima que' starts a new clause.
findings.correct: Se estima que el ejemplar más grande conocido medía unos 9 metros y pesaba unos 1414 kg.

findings.en_sentence: The preserved feathers were long, reaching up to 20 centimeters, and filamentous.
findings.es_sentence: Las plumas conservadas eran largas, alcanzando hasta 20 centímetros, y filamentosas.
findings.correct: Las plumas conservadas eran largas, de hasta 20 centímetros, y filamentosas.

findings.en_sentence: Some researchers previously hypothesized that the structures might be ancestral filamentous structures rather than true feathers.
findings.es_sentence: Algunos investigadores hipotetizaron previamente que dichas estructuras podrían ser formaciones filamentosas ancestrales en lugar de plumas verdaderas.
findings.problem: 'Hipotetizaron' is not in the DLE and calques 'hypothesized'. 'Dichas estructuras' refers to something the section never introduced.
findings.correct: Algunos investigadores plantearon que estos filamentos podrían ser estructuras precursoras de las plumas y no plumas verdaderas.
